lines.en: Thank you both for coming. We need to plan the training day.
lines.zh: 謝謝兩位前來。我們得規劃培訓日。

lines.en: I think Thursday is best. The conference room is free in the morning.
lines.zh: 我想週四最好。會議室早上是空的。

lines.en: Thursday is a problem for me. I have a client meeting at ten.
lines.zh: 週四我有困難。我十點有客戶會議。

lines.en: Can you join us after lunch?
lines.zh: 你可以午餐後再加入我們嗎？

lines.en: Yes. I can come at one o'clock.
lines.zh: 可以。我一點可以到。

lines.en: Then I will book the room until five. Should I order lunch for everyone?
lines.zh: 那我就把會議室訂到五點。要幫大家訂午餐嗎？

lines.en: Yes, please. Order sandwiches for twenty people.
lines.zh: 好，麻煩你。訂二十人份的三明治。

lines.en: I will send the list to the whole team this afternoon.
lines.zh: 我今天下午會把名單寄給全部的團隊。

questions.en: Why is Thursday morning a problem for the coworker?
questions.zh: 為什麼週四早上對這位同事有困難？

questions.en: What does the manager ask the HR person to order?

lines.en: Do you have a minute? I have a problem with tomorrow's presentation.
lines.zh: 你有空嗎？明天的簡報我有個問題。

lines.en: Of course. What is the problem?
lines.zh: 當然。是什麼問題？

lines.en: The new sales numbers will not be ready until Friday.
lines.zh: 新的銷售數字要到週五才會準備好。

lines.en: That is late. Can you show the old numbers first?
lines.zh: 那太晚了。你可以先用舊的數字嗎？

lines.en: I can, but the old numbers are from last year.
lines.zh: 可以，但舊的數字是去年的。

lines.en: Then let us move the presentation to next Monday. I will tell the client.
lines.zh: 那我們把簡報改到下週一。我會告訴客戶。

lines.en: Thank you. I will finish the slides over the weekend.
lines.zh: 謝謝。我週末會把投影片做完。

lines.en: Good. Send them to me by Sunday night.
lines.zh: 好。週日晚上前寄給我。

questions.zh: 這位同事的問題是什麼？
options: The sales numbers will be late
Tell the client about the new day

questions.en: When should the coworker send the slides?
questions.zh: 這位同事應該什麼時候寄投影片？

lines.en: Thank you for joining the call. We have a question about our order.
lines.zh: 謝謝你加入這通電話。我們對訂單有個問題。

lines.en: Of course. Is there a problem with the boxes?
lines.zh: 當然。箱子有問題嗎？

lines.en: The boxes arrived on time. But forty of them are broken.
lines.zh: 箱子準時到了。但有四十個壞了。

lines.en: I am sorry to hear that. I can send forty new ones tomorrow.
lines.zh: 很抱歉聽到這件事。我明天可以再送四十個新的。

lines.en: That is good. Will there be an extra cost?
lines.zh: 那很好。會有額外費用嗎？

lines.en: No, there will be no extra cost. The truck leaves at eight.
lines.zh: 不會，沒有額外費用。卡車八點出發。

lines.en: Please call me when it arrives. I will check every box.
lines.zh: 卡車到的時候請打給我。我會檢查每一個箱子。

lines.en: I will. Thank you for your patience.
lines.zh: 我會的。謝謝你們的耐心。

questions.en: What is wrong with the order?
What will the supplier do tomorrow?
What will the coworker do when the truck arrives?
questions.zh: 卡車到的時候，這位同事會做什麼？

lines.en: The interview for the new accountant is at two. Are you ready?
lines.zh: 新會計師的面試在兩點。你準備好了嗎？

lines.en: Almost. I read her resume last night. It is very good.
lines.zh: 差不多了。我昨晚看了她的履歷。很不錯。

lines.en: She worked at a bank for six years.
lines.zh: 她在銀行工作了六年。

lines.en: Yes, and she speaks three languages. That will help with our clients.
lines.zh: 對，而且她會說三種語言。這對我們的客戶會有幫助。

lines.en: Do you want to ask about her salary today?
lines.zh: 你今天要問她的薪水嗎？

lines.en: No. Let us talk about the job first. We can talk about money next week.
lines.zh: 不用。我們先談工作。錢的事下週再談。

lines.en: Okay. I will bring her to your office at two.
lines.zh: 好的。我兩點會帶她到你的辦公室。

lines.en: Thank you. Please bring two cups of coffee.
lines.zh: 謝謝。請帶兩杯咖啡。

questions.zh: 為什麼她的語言能力會有幫助？

questions.en: When will they talk about the salary?
questions.zh: 他們什麼時候會談薪水？
